scope: White bold reading frame attached to the camera right edge; source-projection avoidance; Unity presentation only

presentation.placement: Camera-facing world-space plane at viewport right with a 1.5 percent right margin; follows camera yaw/pitch; uses right, upper or lower free space outside the source renderer projection
presentation.appearance: 48-point bold white text; white 3-unit frame fitted to each page with 22-unit padding; translucent fade and contained feathered shadow
presentation.depthBoundary: Camera-relative reading plane; no room-wide depth-of-field pass
presentation.compositing: Dedicated layer 31 and disabled render camera, composited after the room retro effect
presentation.controls: Left click to read; mouse remains available for looking; walking and duplicate interactions blocked; left click/Space/Enter to advance, Escape to dismiss
presentation.pagination: Measured text capacity before page fitting; newline paragraphs; every page fully enclosed without clipping
presentation.lifecycle: Pause retains page and stops look; no free readable area temporarily hides frame and blocks page advance; restoring space shows same page; restore/disabled source/host/transitions cancel reading

limits: Mouse-look input route inspected in source; camera-follow tests drive yaw/pitch through FacePoint rather than physical desktop mouse input.
An optional historical ReferenceRoom async run remained running while Editor was stopped; cancelled without a result and not counted as passed.
